name: Video Grain
mechanism:
This method analyzes video grain (film grain / sensor noise) for forensic detection:

1. **Grain패턴추출**: The fine-grained noise/grain pattern is extracted by separating the high-frequency stochastic component from image structure using adaptive filtering. The grain's spatial and statistical characteristics are measured.

2. **GrainModel분석**: The grain model (size, intensity, spatial frequency content, color characteristics) is identified. Camera sensor noise has specific properties: (a) Gaussian-Poisson distribution, (b) sensor-dependent spatial correlation, (c) color-dependent characteristics (more noise in blue channel). The method checks if the grain follows a physical sensor noise model.

3. **Grain공간적Homogeneity**: Camera grain should be spatially homogeneous (uniform sensor produces uniform noise). The method checks grain homogeneity across the frame — different grain characteristics in the face vs. background indicate compositing of content from different sources.

4. **Grain시간적Behavior**: Camera grain is temporally random (uncorrelated between frames) and should renew completely each frame. The method checks temporal grain independence. AI-generated grain may show temporal correlations — persistent grain patterns across frames or correlated grain changes.

5. **Grain-신호Interaction**: Real camera grain is multiplicative (signal-dependent) — brighter regions show more shot noise. The method checks grain-signal dependency. AI generators often add additive noise (signal-independent) or no noise at all, producing an unrealistic grain-signal relationship detectable as a forensic indicator.
parameters:
분석 유형: sensor
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through 비디오 grain analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
